name: PopulateTextField
label: Populate Text Field on Web Page
description: Fills a specified text field in a web browser with provided text. Supports plain or encrypted input.

fields.name: WebBrowserInstance
fields.label: Web Browser Instance
fields.description: Enter or choose the variable that contains the web browser instance to work with.

fields.name: FindType
fields.label: Find Type
fields.description: Specifies how to find the element (e.g., ID, XPath, CssSelector).

selectOptions.label: Relative
selectOptions.description: Find by relative position to another element

selectOptions.label: Automation Id
selectOptions.description: Find by element's automation ID (for WPF/UWP apps)

fields.name: ValueToFind
fields.label: Value To Find
fields.description: The value used to locate the element (e.g., 'username', '//input[@id='email']').

fields.name: TextToPopulate
fields.label: Text To Populate
fields.description: The text to type into the text field.

fields.name: InputMode
fields.label: Input Mode
fields.description: Specifies whether to use plain text or secure string input.

selectOptions.label: Encrypted Text
selectOptions.description: Uses secure string or masked input.

fields.name: FieldContentAction
fields.label: Field Content Action
fields.description: Specifies what to do if the text field already has content.

selectOptions.label: Replace Text
selectOptions.description: Clears existing text and replaces it with new input.

selectOptions.label: Append Text
selectOptions.description: Adds new text to the end of existing text.

fields.name: WaitForElement
fields.label: Wait For Element
fields.description: If true, waits for the element to appear before typing.

fields.name: TimeoutSeconds
fields.label: Timeout Seconds
fields.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the element before failing.

fields.name: EmulateTyping
fields.label: Emulate Typing
fields.description: If true, types character-by-character instead of pasting all at once.

fields.name: UsePhysicalKeystrokes
fields.label: Use Physical Keystrokes
fields.description: If true, uses JavaScript to simulate real keyboard interaction.

fields.name: UnfocusAfterTyping
fields.label: Unfocus After Typing
fields.description: If true, unfocuses the text box after filling it (e.g., to trigger auto-complete).

fields.name: WaitForPageLoad
fields.label: Wait for Page Load
fields.description: If true, waits for the page to fully load before proceeding.

fields.name: IfDialogAppears
fields.label: Handle Dialog
fields.description: Specifies what to do if a dialog appears after populating the field.

selectOptions.label: Close It
selectOptions.description: Automatically close any pop-up dialog that appears.

selectOptions.label: Press a Button
selectOptions.description: Press a specified button on the dialog.

selectOptions.label: Close It / Press a Button
selectOptions.description: Close or press a button on the dialog.

selectOptions.label: Accept Alert
selectOptions.description: Accept the alert dialog that appears.

selectOptions.label: Dismiss Alert
selectOptions.description: Dismiss the alert dialog that appears.

fields.name: DialogButtonToPress
fields.label: Dialog Button to Press
fields.description: The name of the button to press if a dialog appears (e.g., 'Ok', 'Cancel').
